scope: Read-only examination of installed macOS files and pinned public sources. The retained results contain aggregate counts and file identities.

driver_platform_profile_scan.selection: All DriverKit bundle .plist files with 4378, shikoku, honshu, capri or kyushu in their relative path, ignoring case.
driver_platform_profile_scan.interpretation: These four profiles expose no exact named timing or proximity marker in their parsed strings. An encoded field or a capability check elsewhere would fall outside this test.

marker_method.binary_and_text: Split each input into maximal printable ASCII byte runs of length three or longer using [\x20-\x7e]{3,}. Test each Mach-O slice separately using the fat header extents and lipo architecture names.
marker_method.plist: Parse with plistlib and recursively visit dictionary keys and string values, including strings in arrays. Each occurrence in the decoded structure counts separately.
marker_method.matching: Test each marker literally with ASCII case-insensitive matching. Require non-alphanumeric boundaries using (?<![A-Za-z0-9]) and (?![A-Za-z0-9]). Underscore is a separator. Count each run or decoded field at most once per marker.
marker_method.interpretation: A match establishes the presence of a marker in the selected bytes or strings. It gives no evidence about code reachability, feature availability or negotiation. Zero matches leave alternate names, packed metadata and behavior unresolved.

board_text_profiles.selection: Recursively enumerate readable .txt paths in the B1 and B3 trees, including file symlinks. Count distinct resolved paths and SHA-256s separately. Shikoku counts use case-insensitive inclusion in each relative path.
board_text_profiles.interpretation: The shipped BCM4378 text profiles carry per-core proximity offset data, including the Shikoku paths. The scalar field's purpose, the offset units, profile selection at runtime and the ranging protocol remain unverified.

linux_pmsr.scope: Search each pinned brcmfmac cfg80211.c and core.c for the standard start_pmsr, abort_pmsr and pmsr_capa symbols. Check the operation tables and the generic nl80211 dispatch. PMSR means peer measurement.
linux_pmsr.interpretation: The standard Linux peer measurement start requires a registered capability and calls the driver. The two pinned brcmfmac operation tables have no peer measurement handlers. This bounds the standard ranging interface in those sources.

asahi_twt.interpretation: The shared HE station table sets TWT requester, responder, broadcast and flexible scheduling bits directly. The general HE-enable readback gates this table. This path does not read back individual TWT capabilities or apply a BCM4378-specific TWT gate.

broadcom_ftm_control.interpretation: The published Broadcom driver for BCM4383 advertises FTM after a successful compatible firmware interface version response. This demonstrates a distinct capability gate in that driver. It supplies no capability result for BCM4378.

apple_tsf_offset_randomization.supported_macs: All Mac computers from late 2020 or later, with macOS 12.0.1 or later
apple_tsf_offset_randomization.rerandomization: When the interface MAC address changes
apple_tsf_offset_randomization.interpretation: The published support range includes the M1 MacBook Air. Apple describes behavior at the system level, without identifying the split between the host driver and firmware.

runtime_evidence.interpretation: The signed bundle's vocabulary, installed profiles and reference source qualify different parts of the stack. TWT and FTM execution on the stock BCM4378 remain unverified. The TSF finding is model-covered Apple documentation.
